title: Squash and split pea soup with cumin

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Onion, garlic, split peas, squash, stock and spices are all ordinary home cupboard and garden foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs one large pan and a stick blender for soup, both allowed.

works.reason: 200g split peas, 800g squash and 1.5 litres of stock simmered for 50 minutes makes a sensible thick soup for four, and the skin-on squash softens enough to blend.

honest_times.reason: The page was asked to be quick, but the steps need 50 minutes of simmering, so it is over an hour from start to bowl.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming squash soup suits early November, and the squash is the bulk of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Squash and split peas make a filling, wholesome soup that a family would happily eat.
